reviews.summary: The top results are lists of 100+ interchangeable greeting-card lines; this sorts fewer, more specific lines by when to say them and shows in a table how one real detail makes a line yours.

Page one is marriage.com's lists, MomJunction's 400+ and scraped copies; this gives fewer lines, each tied to a moment you'd say it, plus a table that turns a borrowed line into your own.
